:py:mod:`futuram.classes.flows`
===============================

.. py:module:: futuram.classes.flows

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   flows.py

   This module contains the Flow class.

   Classes:
   - Flow: A class representing a flow of material or energy between two points.

   Dependencies:
   - pandas
   - matter.py
   - processes.py



Module Contents
---------------

Classes
~~~~~~~

.. autoapisummary::

   futuram.classes.flows.Flow




.. py:class:: Flow(model, process_from, process_to, composition, unit='kg')


   A class representing a flow of material or energy between two points.

   .. attribute:: name

      The name of the flow.

      :type: str

   .. attribute:: parameters

      A dictionary of parameters associated with the flow.

      :type: dict

   .. attribute:: tags

      A list of tags associated with the flow.

      :type: list

   .. attribute:: to

      The destination of the flow.

      :type: str

   .. attribute:: from_

      The source of the flow.

      :type: str

   .. attribute:: amount

      The amount of material or energy in the flow.

      :type: float

   .. attribute:: composition

      A dictionary representing the composition of the flow.

      :type: dict

   .. attribute:: unit

      The unit of measurement for the flow.

      :type: str

   .. py:method:: set_amount(amount)

      Sets the amount of material or energy in the flow.

      :param amount: The amount of material or energy in the flow.
      :type amount: float

      :raises TypeError: If the amount is not a number.


   .. py:method:: calculate_amount(model)

      Calculates the amount of material or energy in the flow.

      :param model: The model object to use for the calculation.
      :type model: Model


   .. py:method:: set_to(model, process_to)

      Sets the destination of the flow to a process object if in the model
      Adds the process if not in the model

      :param to: The destination of the flow.
      :type to: str


   .. py:method:: set_from(model, process_from)

      Sets the source of the flow to a process object if in the model
      Adds the process if not in the model

      :param from_: The source of the flow.
      :type from_: str


   .. py:method:: validate_flow(flow, model)

      Checks if the flow is valid, i.e. if the composition and the
      linked processes are valid and in the model


   .. py:method:: set_composition(composition)

      Sets the composition of the flow.

      :param composition: A dictionary representing the composition of the flow.
      :type composition: dict

      :raises TypeError: If the composition is not a dictionary or if the keys
          are not strings or the values are not numbers.
      :raises ValueError: If the sum of the composition values is not equal to 1.


   .. py:method:: add_to_model(model)

      Adds the flow to a given model.


   .. py:method:: set_parameter(parameter_name, value)

      Sets a parameter associated with the flow.

      :param parameter_name: The name of the parameter.
      :type parameter_name: str
      :param value: The value of the parameter.


   .. py:method:: get_parameter(parameter_name)

      Gets the value of a parameter associated with the flow.

      :param parameter_name: The name of the parameter.
      :type parameter_name: str

      :returns: The value of the parameter, or None if the parameter does not exist.


   .. py:method:: has_parameter(parameter_name)

      Checks if a parameter is associated with the flow.

      :param parameter_name: The name of the parameter.
      :type parameter_name: str

      :returns: True if the parameter is associated with the flow, False otherwise.


   .. py:method:: remove_parameter(parameter_name)

      Removes a parameter associated with the flow.

      :param parameter_name: The name of the parameter.
      :type parameter_name: str


   .. py:method:: get_all_parameters()

      Gets all parameters associated with the flow.

      :returns: A dictionary of all parameters associated with the flow.


   .. py:method:: clear_parameters()

      Clears all parameters associated with the flow.


   .. py:method:: add_tag(tag)

      Adds a tag to the flow.

      :param tag: The tag to add.
      :type tag: str


   .. py:method:: remove_tag(tag)

      Removes a tag from the flow.

      :param tag: The tag to remove.
      :type tag: str


   .. py:method:: get_tags()

      Gets all tags associated with the flow.

      :returns: A list of all tags associated with the flow.


   .. py:method:: to_dict()

      Converts the flow to a dictionary.

      :returns: A dictionary representing the flow.


   .. py:method:: to_series()

      Converts the flow to a Pandas Series.

      :returns: A Pandas Series representing the flow.
